notes.title: Patch 1.3: New way to taking a weapon and Oculus hardware support
notes.content:
The new patch for Kingdom of Blades has arrived! 
Thank you to all of our players for the great support.

New way to taking a weapon
Now if you want to take a weapon from the weapon shelf, you may take the method shown below.

1.	Focus your eyes to the weapon you want to take from the shelf.
2.	Move your left/right hand to a place where the hand, the weapon and your eyes make a line.
3.	Press the trigger of the corresponding handle.

The tutorial also added several slices of animation to teaching you how to take a weapon from the shelf.
Oculus hardware support
Now you can play Kingdom of Blades with oculus hardware!
Weapon Optimize
We have optimized the models of these weapons
-	Iron Sword
-	Blitz Sword
-	Gluttony Sword
-	Meteor Sword
-	Harden Sword
Open/Close Album 
To players using Vive hardware,:
The same as before.

To players using Oculus hardware:
When you drop off your VR headset, you will see a button in the left corner of your PC monitor labeled “Open Album”. You can click it to open the album.
When the album is open, you will see a button in the left corner of your PC monitor labeled “Close Album”. You can click it to close the album.


Other modifies
1.	We added a rebound effect and an expansion effect to the animation of the lottery egg popping out. The animation speed was also been slightly increased.
2.	We moved the weapon shop lantern from the right of the weapon shelf to the left of the shelf.
3.	Now, after you switched a weapon, there is a 1 second protection time period that you can‘t slice the weapon shop lantern.

notes.title: Patch 1.2: New Chapter and Vive Pro support
notes.content:
The new patch for Kingdom of Blades has arrived!

Thank you to all of our players for the great support.

[h1] The New Chapter - FIRE OF BOWANG [/h1]

Added new chapter FIRE OF BOWANG, after the battle of XuZhou, Someday Cao Cao came across Liu Bei and invited Liu Bei to his mansion. Cao Cao's subordinate considered Liu Bei as a threat ,his men try to assassinate him.
Liu Bei smells a rat and fled as soon as possible.Xiahou Dun and his troops were sent to seize Liu Bei.Finally, Xiahou Dun chased Liu Bei in the Bowang Slope.
By that time Liu Bei has fully prepared for the forthcoming battle.Who will gain supremacy?
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31786657/2d001b6d760bd3e740b12846edd379bcc37b6caf.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added three new kinds of enemies besides common pawns, Darters and Kiters.：
[olist]
 [*] Elite Squad: The experienced ones in Southern Expedition Army, aggressive, deals double damage.
 [*] Armored Southern pawn: The vanguard ones in Southern Expedition Army, need to be sliced twice to eliminate.
 [*] Southern Darter: The supporting ones in Southern Expedition Army, possess a ranged attack by throwing Shuriken to player.
[/olist]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31786657/48789e06ccbb9efa4e274e3e48c66f7b080eea9c.png[/img]
 [*] b.	Added new Boss Xiahou Dun,he is one of the Generals of Cao Cao. When he was fighting with LvBu, he got his left eye blinded. He is good at logistics, and be trusted by Cao Cao deeply.[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31786657/0697497838400cecc385e5e934643e488ab4fc56.png[/img]
Xiahou Dun has two skills: Shockwave and Whirlwind Slash.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31786657/3251f845214974a7301999ba5e89093ec79b6ee6.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31786657/7916b3a2cb8c73d6164b6d359ae72437be91610b.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1] Other new update [/h1]
[list]
 [*] Added new Tips: new boss introduction and how to kill Armored Southern pawn
 [*] Added the enemies and Boss of Chapter 5 to Endless Mode and Boss Mode
 [*] Added 16 new achievements(Chapter 4&5)
[/list]

[h1] Vive Pro support [/h1]
[list]
 [*] Added 3D Audio effect. Hi-Res Audio certified HMD and earphones can make a great improvement in your listening pleasure, no matter the darter who give you a arrows in the back, or the kiter in the air, even the warlord Lv bu , you can easily capture the dangerous sign of  them.
 [*] Added Adaptive Resolution option for most suitable resolution, in different cases of VR hardware.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31786657/c9cf2220aaa20bea6e532ad4561f5c4880fb0f29.jpg[/img][img]

notes.title: Patch 1.1: Optimization
notes.content:
The first patch for Kingdom of Blades has arrived!

Thank you to all of our players for the great feedback you have provided.

[h1] Tutorial [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Adding introduction of Boss normal attack mode and skill attack mode. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31786657/de2b79e4fda80460ca70ec0ef5a451e904740aef.png[/img]
    [*]You can skip the tutorial by pressing  the trigger. New players cannot skip it in order to ensure that you are able to master the game skills faster.
[/list]
[h1] Optimization [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Adjusted the entry of the weapon store, a lantern has been added to the left of the weapon frame. Simply slice the lantern to enter the weapon store and buy your favorite weapons.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31786657/2cf95ea6375286669c3bc8d3d0aea5c4adb58c39.png[/img]
    [*]Now you can share selfies by scanning the QR code generated to share on Wechat and Facebook.
[/list]
[h1] Sound and Effects [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Adding countdown sound effects to Blizzard and Vampire.
    [*]Enhanced and optimized sound effects when you slice enemies.
    [*]Added metal impacts and a spark effects when you hit your weapons together
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31786657/098360b8d242524f1cd889c21fed25c1c089942f.jpg[/img]
    [*]Optimize and reduce the page turning speed of the animation
    [*]Added background story to bosses via the tips page
    [*]Added a flying bird to the scenes
    [*]Optimized the shadows of boss and enemies
[/list]
[h1] Bug Fixes [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Ended the Chinese New Years theme, reverted back to default skin
    [*]Fixed grammatical errors
    [*]Fixed users’ name being incorrectly displayed on the leaderboard.
    [*]Fixed issue where Steam Achievments were not properly unlocked
    [*]Fixed issue where the game won't start if controllers aren't already connected

[/list]
